card.situation:
NPS solicitation for landscaping services at Hassel Island, Virgin Islands National Park — clearing vegetation, removing dead trees, and disposing of debris around historic ruins, with a 150-day performance period.
Reached the owner because NAICS 561730 matches and the small-business set-aside is eligible, but two owner-rule fatals and deep capability gaps were flagged.
reasons_for: NAICS 561730 is self-certified and matches the solicitation exactly, satisfying the primary eligibility screen [808e070c-83acd03b-p2-9bd93187].
Small Business Set Aside - Total is eligible and the firm qualifies as an SBA small business, removing a common disqualifier [profile: set-asides the firm can claim: WOSB, EDWOSB, SBA].
OSHA 30 supervisors, PPE program, CMMS-logged QC inspections, and grounds maintenance past performance at Tinker AFB demonstrate baseline operational capability [808e070c-02b94ab8-p2-ee1dedb5].
reasons_against: FATAL — place of performance is Virgin Islands National Park, St. John, USVI, over 1,500 miles from Oklahoma City, directly violating owner rule [rc-distance] prohibiting bids over 200 miles [808e070c-02b94ab8-p2-db5ddf6c].

FATAL — the 150-day base period (~5 months), even with up to 6 months of options, does not constitute a 12-month base period, violating owner rule [rc-base] prohibiting bids under a 12-month base period [808e070c-02b94ab8-p6-34e244f7].

Firm has no NPS experience, no historic-site or cultural-resource vegetation-clearing capability, and no documented presence or mobilization plan in the USVI, leaving multiple scope-critical requirements as gaps [808e070c-02b94ab8-p4-440035ba].

drafts.capability_statement:
Red Cedar Facility Services — Capability Statement
Submitted in response to: HASSEL ISLAND LANDSCAPING SERVICE | Notice ID: 808e070c0ec749f2bdd8929b448edc78

Red Cedar Facility Services is a Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) and Economically Disadvantaged Woman-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB) certified under NAICS 561730 (Landscaping Services), fully registered in SAM.gov and eligible for this Small Business Set-Aside.

Core Capabilities:
Red Cedar provides grounds maintenance and landscaping services including mowing, trimming, vegetation clearing, and site cleanup. Our supervisory staff hold OSHA 30 certifications, and our workforce operates under a documented PPE and safety program. Quality control inspections are logged in a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS), providing verifiable performance records. We are CIMS-GB certified and maintain e-Verify enrollment in compliance with federal contracting requirements.

Relevant Past Performance:
Red Cedar holds past performance in grounds maintenance at Tinker AFB, Oklahoma, encompassing mowing, trimming, and landscaping of cantonment areas — demonstrating our ability to deliver scheduled, compliant grounds services on an active federal installation.

Administrative Readiness:
We are capable of completing SF18, all representations and certifications, and email-based quote submission per solicitation instructions. We acknowledge the 150-day performance period and the scheduling requirement of Monday through Friday during regular business hours.

Point of Contact:
[Owner Name] | Red Cedar Facility Services | [Phone] | [Email]

Note to Contracting Officer: Red Cedar respectfully requests clarification on several scope and administrative items via the questions submitted alongside this statement.
questions_for_co: Regarding [808e070c-02b94ab8-p6-1f70ce3f] and [808e070c-02b94ab8-p2-db5ddf6c]: The SOW requires the contractor to verify all areas and measurements prior to submitting a bid, and the place of performance is Hassel Island, USVI — is a formal site visit available, and if so, what are the logistics and scheduling details for offerors traveling from the continental United States?

Regarding [808e070c-02b94ab8-p4-440035ba] and [808e070c-02b94ab8-p4-0e90fd49]: The SOW references NPS cultural-resource protocols for clearing vegetation around historic ruins, including restrictions on pulling vines — will the NPS provide a written site-specific cultural-resource protection plan or on-site NPS guidance to the contractor prior to or during performance?

Regarding [808e070c-83acd03b-p6-6a525592], [808e070c-83acd03b-p6-39f8f61a], and [808e070c-83acd03b-p6-685192ab]: The solicitation states liability insurance must be in a form satisfactory to the Contracting Officer with minimums of $50,000 per person, $100,000 per occurrence, and $100,000 property damage — is there a specific insurance form, carrier requirement, or certificate template the Government requires, and must the certificate be submitted with the quote or only prior to award?

Regarding [808e070c-02b94ab8-p6-8d12eabb] and [808e070c-02b94ab8-p2-db5ddf6c]: The SOW requires removal and disposal of all debris and vegetation from the site — are there designated NPS-approved disposal sites on St. John or St. Thomas, or is the contractor responsible for identifying and securing compliant disposal facilities independently?

Regarding [808e070c-83acd03b-p7-575bdd9f]: The solicitation references electronic payment submission — can the Contracting Officer confirm which electronic invoicing system (e.g., IPP) is required, and whether new vendors must enroll prior to award or prior to first invoice submission?

Regarding [808e070c-1957202f-p6-366bbfb7]: The solicitation references a uniform furnishing or reimbursement requirement — does this apply to all labor categories under this contract, and is there a specific uniform specification (color, logo, or NPS-branded requirement) the contractor must meet?

reader.scope_summary: The National Park Service requires a contractor to perform landscaping services at Hassel Island, located within Virgin Islands National Park, 1300 Cruz Bay Creek St. The contractor shall provide all labor, tools, equipment, and personal protective equipment (PPE) to safely perform required tasks including clearing vegetation along road edges and around historic sites, and removing dead trees and debris. The contractor shall also dispose of all generated debris and vegetation, with special care taken to protect historic ruins, artifacts, and visitors throughout the work.

The contractor shall also dispose of all generated debris and vegetation 1.2: LOCATION Virgin Islands National Park 1300 Cruz Bay Creek St.

The option provision may be exercised more than once, but the total extension of performance hereunder shall not exceed 6 months.
Work shall be conducted Monday through Friday, during regular business hours.

Before clearing a structure be sure to evaluate the risks and dangerous areas that must be avoided and never remove vines or plants by pulling on them, as this can result in a collapse and will assuredly result in damage to the building.
